fx-bm.label: Bowlers used per innings by CSK, 2022–2026
fx-bm.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
fx-bm.query: SELECT i.innings_id, CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, CASE WHEN i.bowling_team_id IN (9) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END mine, COUNT(DISTINCT d.bowler_id) bowlers FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2022 AND 2026 GROUP BY i.innings_id

fx-sm.label: Spin share of Chennai Super Kings' overs, 2022–2026
fx-sm.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
fx-sm.query: SELECT pl.name, CASE WHEN i.bowling_team_id IN (9) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END mine, SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id = d.bowler_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2022 AND 2026 GROUP BY pl.name, mine
